Who translated the Bible into Telugu in 1746–47?
x:
Benjamin Schulz (Benjamin Schultze), a German Lutheran missionary associated with the Danish-Halle Mission, was the first person to translate the Bible into Telugu during 1746–47. Recognizing the need to communicate Christian teachings in the local language, he mastered Telugu and undertook the translation of the Bible. His work became a landmark in the history of Telugu prose and printing. The translation also contributed to the development of modern Telugu literature by introducing prose style and encouraging the publication of printed books. Benjamin Schulz's contribution extended beyond religious literature. He also prepared Telugu grammars and dictionaries, helping European scholars understand the Telugu language.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
n: First Telugu Bible Translator – Benjamin Schulz
Contribution – Early Telugu prose and Christian literature

s: Who translated the Bible into Telugu for the first time?
x:
Benjamin Schulz (Schultze) was the first missionary to translate the Bible into Telugu during 1746–47. He mastered the Telugu language and translated the Bible to make Christian teachings accessible to Telugu-speaking people. His work also contributed to the development of modern Telugu prose and printing. Besides the Bible, he prepared linguistic works that helped European scholars learn Telugu. His translation occupies an important place in the history of Telugu literature and missionary activity in South India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
n: First Telugu Bible Translator – Benjamin Schulz

s: In which year American Baptist Mission was established in Andhra
x:
The American Baptist Mission was established in Andhra in 1867. The mission played an important role in spreading modern education, healthcare and Christian missionary activities, especially in the northern coastal districts. It established schools, hospitals, printing presses and educational institutions that contributed to social and educational development in the region.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
n: Contributions – Education, Health and Missionary Activities
